verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a public, plain-language knowledge base covering formation (incorporation packages), financing (SAFE and Series Seed generators), equity (founder stock, 83(b) elections), plus a dedicated guidance section and FAQs, corroborated by independent community mention as a go-to startup resource. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of long-form written explainer articles/FAQ text itself (only page titles/generators), and no additional independent reviews beyond a single HN comment.
